gate: Some lives run on a low fire that never quite goes out. This is that fire. It is the drive to feel a thing all the way through, to want what is wanted because the wanting itself is alive, not because anyone signed off on it and not because it leads anywhere useful. A person carrying this runs hot from the inside. Desire is the weather they live in, and the heat shows up before any decision does. The misread is to confuse the fire with the self, or to read every flare as a command to act now. The heat is information, not an instruction. It is telling you that something is alive for you. It is not telling you to lunge. When the fire is not understood, it grips the nearest object and turns into the suffering of trying to keep what was only ever meant to be felt and let go.
centre_field: This drive lives in the part of you that feels and knows at the same time. That doubling is the whole teaching. Feelings here are not noise on top of your real thinking. They are how the body reads the room, makes heat, and finds meaning, all in one motion. Decisions in this part of you take time. They move in a wave. There is a rising, there is a falling, there is a quiet clearing on the other side, and only in that clearing is the read trustworthy. The misread is to grab any single point of the wave as the truth and act on it. The low side of the wave is not a failure. It is the read completing itself. Welcome the high and the low both, or this part of you becomes a place to hide from instead of a sense you live by.
channel: On its own, this fire has nowhere to start. The wanting is huge, the heat is real, but there is no first move, no signal that says begin. The reach is toward another part of you, the small inner pulse that fantasises forward and says now, the part that imagines a scene and steps into it. The lineage calls this connection the channel of recognition, the long collective wave that hopes hard, pictures the moment in advance, and crashes when the picture does not match what arrives. Alone, the feeling turns inward as longing with no exit. Joined, the longing finds its first step and the imagination finds its emotional weight. The highs run high and the lows run low because the desire is hitched to a picture, and pictures break. The completion is not relief from the wave. It is the wave doing the work it was made to do.
